quote: is probably the most honest way i can describe myself.
paragraphs: Growing up, that meant drawing, painting, sculpting, diy-ing my clothes, building kingdoms in Minecraft, and starting a journaling Youtube channel. If I could make it, I was making it.

That same energy is what eventually led me to Interactive Media Arts at NYU, where I get to explore the blurry, exciting overlap between fine art, graphic design, computing, and innovation. I've designed editorials for NYU FBA's zine Vis Major, built out brand identities and illustrations for independent projects, and i run a personal TikTok (@actuallymiyaa) that started as a way to document outfits i loved and wanted to remember.
I'm still pretty new to digital and web design, but as with any art form, you just have to sit with the confusion long enough to figure it out, and I'm very much in that process.

People say I'm type A because I'm always the one with the color-coded itinerary for the group trip. Fair, but day to day I'm more of a 70/30 split: organized enough to get things done, messy enough to keep it fun.
